command: Human EIF4E2/4EHP is a component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex (GO:0016281) under hypoxia. Interpret the actual GO complex definition and assess the composition of eIF4E2/eIF4G3/eIF4A complexes in primary studies, distinguishing them from canonical eIF4E1/eIF4G1 complexes and GIGYF-mediated repression. Evaluate whether hypoxic eIF4F-H is an instance of this GO complex and whether EIF4E2 itself supports cap-dependent translation initiation in that context. A repressive function in other complexes does not exclude an initiation role.
